stories.headline: Nabers Dodges the Laid-Up List, and Big Blue's Whole Offense Breathes Again
stories.read: Straight off the wire out of West Virginia, pardner: the Giants stashed three fellas on the laid-up list and Malik Nabers wasn't one of 'em. That means no restrictions in practice, and it's the first hard evidence in months that his busted wheel might actually hold up come Week 1. Now hold up before you go all-in, 'cause Harbaugh already warned this knee ain't a simple fix, but the saloon's been pricin' Nabers like damaged goods and he's still the only field-tilter in that whole receiver room. That's a discount on a fella who's a top-shelf haul the second he's whole. Stake your claim while the herd's still spooked.

stories.headline: Jonathon Brooks Rode Into Camp Full-Go and Canales Nearly Wept
stories.read: Now here's the vein I been pannin' for all summer. Brooks took the field as a full participant for the first time in his whole NFL life, and Dave Canales came off that practice sayin' he looks fast, looks strong, looks like the guy I remember. Two torn-up knees in two years buried this fella so deep the saloon forgot he existed, and Chuba Hubbard's still nominally holdin' the reins, but the insiders all figure Brooks takes over the backfield before the leaves turn. A lead-back haul at a bargain-bin price is exactly the diamond in the rough that wins you the big pot. Grab him three rounds before your leaguemates remember his name.

stories.headline: Tyreek Hill Says His Left Leg's Got No Power, and That's a Dry Well, Pardner
stories.read: The Cheetah put out a rehab video this week and then said the quiet part out loud: ten months and two surgeries after that knee came apart, he's got no power in his left leg at all. He's still a free agent, still got no team, still got no timetable, and he's thirty-two years old. I admire the grit, truly, but a fella whose whole trade is runnin' past folks tellin' you the runnin' ain't back yet is a wagon with a wheel already in the ditch. Let somebody else in your outfit spend the pick on the name, and you go spend yours on somebody who'll actually be on the range in September.
